source.description:
## PROBLEM

xt log is only discoverable if it appears in xt help, CLAUDE.md, and the using-* skills. Otherwise operators will keep juggling three CLIs.

## SUCCESS

- xt help lists log with a one-line description
- README.md gets a short section on unified observability
- CLAUDE.md 'Essential command surface' adds \`xt log\` alongside xt debug + xt topology
- ~/.xtrm/skills/default/using-specialists/references/monitoring.md and starting-and-resuming-work reference xt log where appropriate
- 'Current gotchas' notes Phase B (native forensic in xtmux + xt debug) is in-flight

## SCOPE

- README.md
- CLAUDE.md
- cli/src/commands/help.ts (if scripted)
- ~/.xtrm/skills/default/using-specialists/references/monitoring.md
- ~/.xtrm/skills/default/starting-and-resuming-work/SKILL.md

## NON_GOALS

- Do not rewrite xtrm docs architecture.
- Do not touch xtmux README (that's B3) or specialists README.

## CONSTRAINTS

- Keep additions terse; do not duplicate command help.
- SCRUTINY: low.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] npm run check:payload-hygiene passes
- [ ] xt help contains 'log' entry
- [ ] Skills resolve

## LIBRARIES

- **Reuse in repo:** existing doc templates
- **New dep candidate:** none
- **Roll it:** yes

## OUTPUT

Diff of updated files + brief note on touched skills.
source.title: A6: docs + skill routing for xt log (Phase A)
